description: Locked theorem-backed zero invariants for decision-bearing continuous screening. These are exact runtime/completeness obligations, not empirical quality or latency calibration.
observed_paired_sd_by_metric_contract: Per-metric paired-delta SD (candidate minus control, same fixture id) consumed by screening_sample_size.lookup_paired_sd_for_metric for the screening power floor and the power_decidability preflight. Keys are the metric leaf (e.g. eval_nll) or the full metric (e.g. smoke.eval_nll); values are a number/fraction string or an object {sd, n_deltas, source}. A metric absent here is unmeasured: the exact decidability floor stands alone and preflight warns instead of blocking. Never copy another metric's SD into a slot.
